strings.lobby.description:
Chat under unusual rules!

I'm waiting on 3 players to join. Once play begins, rules apply to everyone posting in this exact channel. Start a message with `-# ` to whisper: the whole message is exempt.

The invitation lasts three minutes. Use /rules for current rules. A manager can end the game with /end-game.

Rules evolve as the conversation continues. Keep chatting for a chance to choose the next one.

strings.warning.description:
Get ready! Another Rule is coming! Everyone who chats has a chance to choose.

Picker selection is in 30 seconds from this notice’s publication. The current rules stay in effect.
